seo_description: First-generation California scholarships under ten thousand dollars: compare awards, deadlines, and requirements, then apply on official USA program pages.
intro: Trying to find California scholarships for first-generation students with awards under this cap usually means balancing fit, timing, and effort. This filtered slice brings together a focused set of USA listings where first-generation eligibility and California location matter, so you can compare options without wading through unrelated programs. The rows below span areas like community, education, arts, and miscellaneous topics, with study levels that can include high school seniors and graduate students. Award amounts vary by listing, deadlines differ by program, and requirement details are not identical, so it helps to read each row closely. Many listings in this slice appear to have lighter application signals and often no essay, but you should still verify every requirement on the official page before you apply.
supporting: Use this view to compare more than just the title. Check how each listing describes eligibility, location fit, study level, and field of study, then note which programs seem closest to your background. Because deadline text appears across these rows and some dates may be coming up soon, it is smart to review timing early. If an award catches your eye, open the official source to confirm the current amount, required materials, and any California-specific details before you shortlist it.
related_intro: If you do not find the right match here, compare nearby scholarship pages by changing one filter at a time, such as location, eligibility, or award range. That makes it easier to spot California options with a different focus or first-generation scholarships in other USA filter combinations.

faq.question: What should I check before I apply to a scholarship from this list?
